title: Open missing direct debit records
steps: View the loaded direct debit order list.
Open /compta/prelevement/card.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting order page.
Open /compta/prelevement/fiche-rejet.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting rejects page.
Open /compta/prelevement/fiche-stat.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting statistics page.
Open /compta/prelevement/line.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting line page.

video_guide.summary: The missing order and line links now show an explicit record-not-found message while retaining application navigation.

chapters.label: Review the direct debit order list

chapters.note: The recording starts on the direct debit order list.
The missing order card is replaced by Enregistrement non trouve (record not found).
The missing Rejects request also shows record not found.
The missing Statistics request shows record not found instead of a zero-valued card.
The missing line request ends with the same explicit not-found outcome and the normal navigation still available.
